panels.description: Filesystem usage percentage for mounted PVCs, collected from kubelet volume stats.

targets.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

panels.title: PVC Used Percent

panels.description: Used and capacity bytes for mounted PVCs, collected from kubelet volume stats.

targets.expr: kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

panels.title: PVC Used and Capacity

panels.description: PVC inode usage percentage from kubelet volume stats.

targets.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

panels.title: PVC Inode Used Percent

panels.description: PVCs reported as abnormal by kubelet volume health status.

targets.expr: kubelet_volume_stats_health_status_abnormal{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}) == 1

panels.title: Abnormal PVC Health

panels.description: PVC count for the selected storage class. Requires kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: count(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}) OR on() vector(0)

panels.title: PVCs

panels.description: PVC phase count for the selected storage class. Requires kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))

panels.title: PVC Phase

panels.description: Total requested storage for selected PVCs. Requires kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: sum(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))

panels.title: Requested Storage

panels.description: PVCs with the highest filesystem usage percentage.

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))
